baseline.dependencyReuse: symlink only; no install; source and installed lock bytes matched before build

sourceAudit.note: Point-in-time source evidence only; final candidate build and browser captures remain pending. AST uses existing TypeScript printer with removeComments:true.

checks.httpSmoke: 1 test passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped; two disposable loopback roots; no browser

usage.temporaryBaselineOnly: After baseline build exit 0, both positional roots may explicitly name the baseline dist/public while candidate build is pending. Both origins then serve baseline bytes; never label the second origin candidate proof.
usage.output: Two JSON lines with phase, root, ephemeral 127.0.0.1 origin, pid and entry URL. No default production root, app server, proxy or provider calls.
usage.scenario: Navigate to /employer/talent?fixture=<scenario> before each case. This resets synthetic per-session state. Separate cookie names keep baseline and candidate ports independent.
usage.interactions: Use actual UI controls: unlocked row B View profile/Send intro request; locked row A Unlock profile; Search talent Go and Filter by location Pune then Search; retry case starts with 503 then succeeds through Try again. Profile/profile-cleared/search/intro-sent/unlock-confirmed are normal starting responses; their named state requires the UI action.
usage.pendingRequests: loading and unlock-pending hold their API response until GET /__fixture/release in the SAME synthetic cookie session. /__fixture/status shows pending count, method/path calls, refused calls and balance; no provider or identity secrets.
usage.isolation: Use a clean browser with no old service worker. CSP blocks remote connections/scripts/styles/fonts, frames and workers; sw.js is deliberately unavailable. All unlisted /api requests, including checkout and unlisted tRPC procedures, return 501 and are logged. Static index/assets are served byte-for-byte unchanged.
usage.captureRequirement: Main agent verifies before/after at 1280 and 390, records actual method/path failures and screenshots, and checks /__fixture/status refused list. This receipt is not browser evidence.
